summary: Designed replay-only transport (pause/play, rewind 150 ticks, speeds 1/2/4, seek) with snapshot-every-120 seek cache for ≤500ms/NFR-2 parity to stepMatch, plus client MediaRecorder export at 720×1280@30 with MIME order mp4×3 then webm×3 and honest labels. nextStage: implementer (design-ux not required).
goal: Climb replay should allow fast forwarding, rewind, pause/play. Export as mp4.

learnings.insight: Seek/rewind for deterministic input-log replay uses a climb-tick snapshot cache every SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL_TICKS=120: clone nearest floor snapshot, step forward at most 119 ticks; never mutate stored snapshots; parity oracle is createMatch→drain countdown→apply inputs[0..target-1] via stepMatch.
learnings.action: Implement ReplaySnapshotCache per loop/architecture.md ADR-1; assert player.y and peakY against the headless oracle (AC-6). Do not full-resim from 0 on every seek.

learnings.insight: Export MIME probe order is locked: video/mp4;codecs=avc1.42E01E → avc1.4D401E → video/mp4 → video/webm;codecs=vp9 → vp8 → video/webm. Success UI and filename extension must follow the chosen container; never label WebM as MP4.
learnings.action: Implement pickExportMime with injectable isTypeSupported for unit tests; wire AC-15/AC-17 copy from ExportMimeChoice.label.

learnings.insight: NFR-8 requires transport/export to be inert when replaying===false: useClimb must gate pause/speed/seek refs and return transport:null for live play so the live rAF path pays no new per-frame React subscriptions.
learnings.action: Branch all new control state behind replaying; mount ReplayTransportBar / useReplayExport only when ClimbScene has a decoded replay.

learnings.insight: Replay shortcuts must use shouldCaptureReplayKey with the same isInteractiveTarget exemption as shouldCaptureGameKey so Space/k/J/L do not steal focus from mute/Start/buttons (AC-3 negative).
learnings.action: Export a testable predicate; add interactive-target fixtures in verifier coverage.

learnings.insight: Architect stage confirms free-leaderboard trust-boundary remains open and out of scope for replay transport/export; no climb/result or score-write changes in this design.
learnings.action: Implementer must not touch climb result persistence while shipping transport/export.

learnings.insight: Architecture locks REWIND_STEP_TICKS=150, REPLAY_SPEEDS=[1,2,4], SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL_TICKS=120, export 720x1280@30 silent, countdown frames skipped in encode (ADR-2), visibility policy pause-on-hidden (ADR-4).
learnings.action: Treat these as normative constants in code and tests; duration assertion uses N/30 not N/30+3.

openQuestions: Audio mux in export remains Future (v1 silent).

notes.seekStrategy: snapshot every 120 climb ticks; clone+step ≤119; forward micro-seek can step from current
